about_the_game:
Two Hidden Object Adventures Where Monsters and Mysteries Collide

Step into a world where legendary creatures and curious minds meet. These two Hidden Object games combine mystery, monsters, and adventure across vivid 360-degree scenes with rich animation and 3D effects.

Uncover clues, collect rewards, and return to quests with new puzzles. Whether you're in it for the thrill or the challenge, there's always more to explore.

Game Highlights

  • Search in immersive 360-degree panoramic scenes

  • Look behind objects, secrets might be hiding out of sight

  • Replay quests with fresh puzzles and bonus rewards

  • Explore environments inspired by monster legends and lore

Trap for Monsters

You are part of an ancient secret order, sworn to keep the balance between good and evil. Now the order’s powerful amulet has been stolen under the full moon.

Investigate the lairs of mythical creatures including a werewolf, a ghost, a mummy, and a forest spirit. Explore castles, enchanted woods, and hidden chambers as you follow a trail of clues toward the truth.

Vampire

A young heroine becomes the unwilling player in a vampire’s cruel game. If she succeeds, she earns her freedom. If she fails, she becomes his next meal.

Solve puzzles, navigate deadly traps, and collect pieces of a sacred amulet. Escaping the castle is only the beginning. The darkest secrets are still waiting to be revealed.
